standard_prerequisites.name: The identification of the derived sections of a twist of the pullback of a quasi-coherent module with the derived tensor product of the module with the corresponding ideal power
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author lemma lemma-compute-tor-Iq, invoked at the start of the counted proof (source line 4682)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the Tor modules to be bounded into the cohomology of the twist of the pullback on the blowup.

standard_prerequisites.name: The annihilation of the cohomology sheaves of the pullback in the degrees below the negative of the number of generators by a fixed power of the ideal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author lemma lemma-annihilates, invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 4700-4703)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the single constant that annihilates every term of the filtration.

core_obligations: Translate to the blowup: using the identification of the derived sections with the derived tensor product, the proof writes the Tor modules as the cohomology of the twist of the pullback of the module (proof lines 4678-4682)

Filter through a spectral sequence: the bounded and convergent spectral sequence computing the Tor modules from the cohomology of the twists gives a finite filtration with at most d steps, where d is the constant that bounds the number of affines needed to cover the complement of the support, and whose graded pieces are subquotients of the cohomology of the twists of the pulled back sheaves (proof lines 4683-4699)

Annihilate the pieces: beyond the number of generators every one of those graded pieces is annihilated by the fixed power coming from the annihilation lemma for the pullback sheaves, so the Tor modules of the ideal powers are annihilated by a bounded power (proof lines 4700-4705)

Pass to the quotient: the short exact sequence relating the ideal power to the structure sheaf transfers the annihilation to the Tor modules of the quotients, and a larger power handles the finitely many small exponents (proof lines 4705-4710)
proof_roadmap: 由 lemma-compute-tor-Iq 把 RΓ(X, Lp^*M(q)) 换成 M ⊗^L_A I^q；再用跨章的谱序列 H^a(X, H^b(Lp^*M(q))) ⇒ Tor_{-a-b}(M, I^q) 得到 Tor_i(M, I^q) 的一个步数 ≤ d 的有限滤过，其分次商是 H^a(X, H^{-i-a}(Lp^*M)(q)) 的子商。
i ≥ t 时这些分次商都被 I^c 零化（lemma-annihilates），故 I^{dc} 零化 Tor_i(M,I^q)；再用 0 → I^q → A → A/I^q → 0 转移到 Tor_i(M, A/I^q)，最后取 m = max(dc, q(A,I)-1) 覆盖一切 q ≥ 0。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement exhibits a power of the ideal, depending only on the ideal, that annihilates all the Tor modules of any module against the powers of the ideal in degrees above an upper bound for the number of generators (author lemma at source lines 4668-4675, label lemma-annihilates-tors). The proof (source lines 4677-4711) replaces the Tor modules by the cohomology of twists of a pullback along the blowup, filters them by the two-variable spectral sequence of that pullback, annihilates the graded pieces by the constant provided by the chapter's earlier annihilation statement, and then transfers the annihilation back through the short exact sequence defining the quotients, with an explicit bookkeeping of the exponents dc and q(A, I) - 1 (proof lines 4700-4710). The spectral-sequence filtration with its precise degree bookkeeping is the content. H2.
